title: Copula Geometry and Second-Order Calibration of Heavily Right Aggregation
summary: Heavy-tailed $p$-value combination tests are attractive under unknown dependence because their null tails can be first-order robust even when the exact dependent null distribution is unavailable. That robustness does not resolve calibration: $\Pr\{T>q(α)\}=α+o(α)$ neither quantifies the remaining size error nor determines its sign. We develop a second-order calibration theory for positive Half-Cauchy and reciprocal, or harmonic-mean, aggregation.
